title: Phytochemical composition comprising Boswellia serrata and Commiphora mukul for synovial protection
text: DETAILED DESCRIPTION: The invention addresses joint degradation through non-overlapping pathways. AKBA binds directly to 5-lipoxygenase, while guggulsterone antagonizes the farnesoid X receptor and prevents degradation of I-kappa-B-alpha, preventing NF-kappa-B nuclear translocation.
